criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: The underlying audio-video model and a publisher product-LoRA clip establish relevance; exact ASIN reference conditioning and first-10-seconds identity are untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Publisher supplies complete MP4/FLAC artifacts plus all-frame picture and audio-distance metrics for one 249-frame run; no AIVP run or human quality panel.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Seed, dimensions, frames, steps, sigmas, sampler and saved-conditioning identity control are documented; multi-seed and three-run repeatability remain unknown.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Single-file checkpoint and ComfyUI tooling are documented, but the encoder-conditioning workaround, large assets and specialist GPU setup add material friction.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Publisher separates 18-second sampling from 208-second whole-run time and documents six failed BF16 loading attempts; repeated W4A8 failure rate is unknown.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Weights are downloadable without per-render vendor fees; hardware, electricity, setup and cost per accepted output are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: LTX-2 terms grant use subject to restrictions, a US$10M entity-revenue threshold and generated-content disclosure; AIVP must archive current terms before use.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: ComfyUI, conversion, benchmark and conditioning-control tooling are public; no audited AIVP MCP or production integration exists.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Ungated weights are geographically accessible and the licence is worldwide, but the demonstrated multi-GPU setup is specialist hardware.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate programme or validated transactional demand was found.

analysis: An unusually transparent W4A8 deployment derivative with synchronized audio-video files, conditioning controls and LoRA evidence. It is still a specialist component, not a turnkey creator tool; exact-product fidelity, vertical output, repeatability, security and accepted-output economics remain unverified.
confidence_notes: Publisher repository, benchmark artifacts and upstream primary documentation only; no AIVP controlled run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Blocked pending three-run exact-product first-frame/first-10-seconds success.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; Review blocked pending controlled AIVP evidence.
hard_gates.integration: Blocked: no NVIDIA GPU on current host, large-file security scans incomplete, paid compute not approved.
